saw_lines: Dancers choose by fit and feel, replace worn pairs, and ask other dancers before they buy.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before a dancer weighs fit and feel.
Your site shows 50,000+ orders, yet none of your 24 ads carry that number. Put it in the first line of each creative, and open two ads with a dancer’s review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 50,000+ orders, yet none of your 24 ads carry that number. Buyers need that proof before trusting a new shoe. Put 50,000+ in the first line of every creative, and open two ads with a dancer’s review quote.

Your site promotes free shipping from a purchase value of 60, yet none of your 24 ads mention it. First-time buyers hesitate over cost before they click, so open new ads with that line in the first sentence.

6 of your 22 copy ads open on the same line, while the other openers are single use, so one hook carries the account. Write two openers around the anti-odor insole and grip sole, and test both against it this week.

The site promotes free shipping, yet 0 of 22 ads mention it, so a shopper comparing styles has no reason to pick you. Answer the shipping question in the first line of the SMOVE and Fuego ads for new buyers.
